newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.538 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 91-day Treasury bills yield 6.538 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Wednesday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.538 percent at its auction of 91-day Treasury bills for 100 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on August 21 for 150 million ringgit, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.541 percent.
The bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.545/520 percent against 6.550/500 a week ago, the central bank said.
At its auction of 182-day bills, also for 100 million ringgit, the bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.514 percent.
The bids accepted were in the high/low range of 6.538/479.
